title: Amazon API Gateway to AWS Lambda to AWS IoT
description: Create an API Gateway REST API to invoke a Lambda function to publish to IoT Core.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern creates an Amazon API Gateway REST API endpoint, that invokes a Lambda function.
The Lambda function has been given permissions to publish to AWS IoT Core (`iot:Publish`). Make a POST call to the API Endpoint with `topic` and `message` in the body.
This pattern deploys an API Gateway resource and one Lambda function.
See the GitHub repo for detailed testing instructions.
